limits: Unoriented exact mesh triangle intersections are a diagnostic; native sidedness/filtering/contact skin is unproved.
Support is a downward geometric ray at the eye position, not a native player shape contact or movement proof.
Only listed fixed geometry is considered; animated doors, other structures and native collision state are not recovered by this check.
No point or hypothesis is discarded based on support, occlusion or residual.
Low residual alone cannot identify a duplicated source component or native illumination.
